newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Oil to sell engine oil made by BP and Agip.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Oil to sell engine oil made by BP and Agip.

text.p: Nippon Oil Co Ltd said on Tuesday it plans to begin sales in January of engine oil manufactured by British Petroleum Co Plc (BP) and Italy's Agip.
Nippon Oil's service stations already sell Caltex Petroleum Corp engine oil as well as Nippon Oil's own brand.
The leading Japanese oil firm started selling engine oil made by Caltex, a joint venture between U.S. majors Chevron Corp and Texaco Inc, in July.

Nippon Oil aims to sell 300 kilolitres (kl) of engine oil made by each of the three foreign manufacturers in the business year starting from next April, and 1,000 kl each in the year after, a company spokesman said.
There are about 10,000 service stations in Japan that are affiliated to Nippon Oil.
